name: AdmissionConsentForm
title: Admission Consent Form
description: Consent to undertake a rehabilitation programme, with the cardinal rules and ground norms the client accepts on admission.

item.text: Rehabilitation is an active participation in a special therapy designed to help one transition from a dependent role to a holistic recovery. A team of highly skilled professionals develops a programme in consultation with the patient to meet individual needs and to ensure maximum benefit.
Client
Name
ID number
Consent to treatment
I wish to undertake the rehabilitation programme, which has been explained to me, and I consent to treatment as advised and recommended.
I understand that the programme takes a minimum of ninety (90) days, and I agree to the terms and conditions below for that period.
Cardinal rules
Drugs: I shall not at any time use or be found in possession of drugs, within or outside the premises, during the treatment period.
Sex: no sexual act of any kind is acceptable during the treatment period.
Violence: no verbal, physical or emotional abuse, including threats to staff or fellow clients, is allowed.
Destruction of property: I shall respect the property of clients, staff, the centre and the neighbourhood; destroying it will be penalised.
Theft: no theft of property belonging to fellow clients, staff, the centre or neighbours will be tolerated.
Ground norms
I shall never leave the compound without permission from staff.
I shall not steal or abuse.
I shall maintain the required standards of hygiene.
I shall abstain from all mood-altering substances.
I shall adhere to the daily programme and all required activities, and shall not abscond from the programme or any of its activities.
I shall be responsible and uphold the set virtues and the moral and spiritual standards.
I shall not be found in possession of illegal items, for example knives, phones or drugs.
Key virtues: honesty, humility and self-acceptance.
Signature
The client has signed this form
Date signed
